ground_truth_protocol.description: CIP explicit messages carried in EtherNet/IP SendRRData / SendUnitData; the CIP service code (with the reply bit) selects the message type. Derived from the Wireshark/tshark dissection of the benchmark capture (dol/truth-file-derivation/scripts/build_truth.py): fields at a fixed offset in at least 60% of a type's messages, bitfields sharing a byte merged, arrays of 3+ equal fields and variable-position content kept as one bytes field (the modbus.json convention for register arrays); types with fewer than 5 messages are omitted.
ground_truth_protocol.offset_convention: Encapsulation header fields use wire-absolute offsets 0..23; CIP message types are relative to offset 24 (interface handle, timeout, common packet format items, then the CIP message).
